title: AI and homework: smart learning or cheating?
situation: An international student website has started a discussion with the title "AI tools for homework: smart learning or cheating?" Write a post in which you give your opinion on the question.
situationHu: Egy nemzetközi diákportál vitát indított arról, hogy a mesterséges intelligencia használata a házi feladathoz okos tanulás vagy csalás; írj fórumbejegyzést.

points.text: describe how students you know use AI tools for school work
explain how these tools can help students learn
discuss the dangers of relying on AI for homework
suggest some fair rules for using AI at school

modelAnswer.text:
In my opinion, AI is neither pure cheating nor a miracle – it all depends on how we use it.

At my school in Debrecen, almost everyone I know uses chatbots in some way. Some of my classmates ask them to explain maths problems or check the grammar of their essays, while others simply copy whole answers without even reading them.

Used wisely, these tools can be extremely helpful. A chatbot never gets tired of your questions, so it can explain a difficult concept again and again until you understand it. I often ask one to quiz me before a history test, which is far more effective than rereading my notes.

However, the danger is that students stop thinking for themselves. If an AI writes your essay, you will never learn how to organise your ideas, and you will struggle in exams where no technology is allowed. What is more, chatbots sometimes give wrong information with complete confidence, so trusting them blindly can be risky.

That is why I believe schools need clear and fair rules. Students should be allowed to use AI for practice and explanations, but they should always say when and how they used it. Teachers could also require students to write important assignments in class or explain their work orally.

To sum up, AI is a smart learning tool as long as we stay in charge of our own thinking.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: mind a négy szempont külön bekezdést kap konkrét példával (matekmagyarázat, kikérdezés a történelemdolgozat előtt, gép nélküli vizsga), a nyitó és a záró mondat pedig egyértelműen állást foglal a kérdésben.

Szövegalkotás: világos érvelő felépítés (vélemény – tapasztalat – előnyök – veszélyek – szabályok – összegzés), a bekezdéseket változatos kötőszavak kapcsolják össze: However, What is more, That is why, To sum up.
Hangnem: félhivatalos fórumbejegyzés összevont alakok nélkül, de személyes példákkal – ez illik egy nemzetközi diákportálhoz.

Szókincs és nyelvhelyesség: B2-es szerkezetek, pl. a melléknévi igenévvel kezdett mondat (Used wisely, …), a neither … nor és a feltételes mondat (If an AI writes your essay, you will never learn …). Érdemes megtanulni: stop thinking for themselves, trust them blindly, stay in charge of our own thinking.
